## Other content
Procedural coating maps and recognition geometry changes are original implementation artwork. Existing imagery, brand marks, model and particle images retain their pre-existing rights; they are not reclassified as CC0. Live ESRI/CARTO credits remain visible in the application.

Library notices remain supplied by their original packages (Three/three-stdlib MIT, Cesium Apache-2.0, postprocessing Zlib).


## User-supplied generated color inputs (2026-09-05)
The original generated concrete and faded-paint inputs supplied for this task are
used as **sRGB base-color detail only** on the existing inspector contact disc and
painted recognition-model surfaces. They are not scanned or physically validated
normal, height, metallic, roughness, AO or opacity maps. Optimized 256/512px JPEG
variants are produced; the paint contrast is reduced to 0.6 for restrained wear.
The manifest records signed-URL-free source URLs, input/variant hashes, timestamps
and the user's generated-asset status. This is not a CC0 assertion.
The asphalt, architectural-glass and soot inputs were decoded and inspected but
not added: there is no matching physical surface in the constructed scene.
